description: Find the payback, estimated term and true APR of a merchant cash advance from its factor rate, fees and remittances. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

advance.description: Advance amount (purchase price) (US dollars). The advance amount written in the agreement, before any fees are taken out.

dailySales.description: Estimated card sales per sales day (US dollars). Your typical card sales on a day you are open, from processor statements. Used only when method is holdback; ignored otherwise.

factor.description: Factor rate (×). The multiplier in the agreement; payback = advance × factor rate. For example 1.35.

fees.description: Fees taken out of the advance or paid at funding (US dollars). Origination, underwriting, admin or broker fees paid when the advance is funded.

frequency.description: Remittance frequency. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for remittance frequency. Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when method is fixed; ignored otherwise. Options: daily = Each business day (5 per week); weekly = Weekly.

holdback.description: Holdback percentage of card sales. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. The share of each day’s card sales the provider collects. Used only when method is holdback; ignored otherwise.

method.description: How is the advance repaid?. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for how is the advance repaid?. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: holdback = A holdback % of daily card sales; fixed = A fixed daily or weekly remittance.

payment.description: Fixed remittance amount (US dollars). The fixed amount debited each business day or each week. Used only when method is fixed; ignored otherwise.

salesDays.description: Sales days per week (days). Days per week with card sales collected. Used only when method is holdback; ignored otherwise.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_merchant_cash_advance_true_apr

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.

title: Merchant cash advance true APR
